# Author Correction: SHERLOCK: nucleic acid detection with CRISPR nucleases

Max J. Kellner, Jeremy G. Koob, Jonathan S. Gootenberg, Omar O. Abudayyeh and Feng Zhang

Correction to: Nature Protocols https://doi.org/10.1038/s41596-019-0210-2, published online 23 September 2019.

In the version of this article initially published, three of the sensitivity values in the bottom table in Box 1 were incorrect. The value for LwaCas13a should have been 5e7 aM, not ~5e5 aM; the value for CcaCas13b should have been ~5e7 aM, not ~5e6 aM; and the value for PsmCas13b should have been ~5e9 aM, not ~5e8 aM. In addition, the ‘Anticipated results’ section should not have mentioned Fig. 1d; Fig. 1 has no panel d. The errors have been corrected in the HTML and PDF versions of the article.

Published online: 31 January 2020
